{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"Nuvolve CRM API","version":"1.0.0","description":"Connect Nuvolve to your own systems: a data warehouse, accounting, call tracking, ad platforms, or Zapier.

**Keys.** An owner or admin makes keys in Settings → API & integrations. Each key belongs to one company, has only the permissions picked for it, and can be held to one branch. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer nvk_...`. A key is shown once; turning it off takes effect right away.

**Lists** come newest first, 25 at a time (up to 100 with `limit`). When `has_more` is true, pass `next_cursor` as `starting_after`.

**Retries.** Send an `Idempotency-Key` header on any POST or PATCH. Sending the same key again within 24 hours returns the first answer and does nothing new.

**Limits.** 120 requests a minute per key. Watch the `X-RateLimit-Remaining` header; a 429 comes with `Retry-After`.

**Rules.** Your company's scheduling rules (card on file, licensed tech, price floor, service area…) apply to the API too. A blocked request gets a 422 with `error.rules` listing each one. Keys can't override rules.

**Webhooks.** Every delivery is a POST of an Event with these headers: `Nuvolve-Event`, `Nuvolve-Event-Id`, `Nuvolve-Delivery`, and `Nuvolve-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>`. v1 is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<raw body>` using the webhook secret. Answer with any 2xx within 10 seconds. Anything else is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 12 h. Answer 410 to unsubscribe. A webhook that gives up on 5 events in a row is switched off.

**Events:** `customer.created` (a customer is added), `customer.updated` (a customer is changed), `lead.created` (a new lead comes in (website booking or the api)), `service_request.created` (a
